subject: Change runner to remove the IndexOutofBounds Exception

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Change runner to remove the IndexOutofBounds Exception
parts:
Setting this helped me:

rhoptions(runner="./Rfolder-test/Rdist/RhipeMapReduce --slave --silent
--vanilla --max-ppsize=100000")

(it had -max-nsize=1G, which caused errors)

HTH

messages.subject: Re: Change runner to remove the IndexOutofBounds Exception
parts:
I runned into the same problem when I increased the file size.
Porbably, I did not get how to set the rhoptions. If I uncomment the rhoptions line in 'e' the error is gone but the ofolder becames empty. Is this how I should set up rhoptions?

Thank you

e <-function (ifolder) {
    m <- rhmap({
                rhcollect(k, r)
            })
   
    z <- rhwatch(rhmr(map=m
            ,ifolder=ifolder
            #,rhoptions(runner="/usr/lib64/R/library/Rhipe/bin/RhipeMapReduce --slave --silent --vanilla --max-ppsize=100000")
            ,ofolder="/tmp/lixo"
            ,inout=c("sequence", "sequence")
          ))
}

messages.author: 0c2bffd1ce4a1edd
messages.subject: Re: Change runner to remove the IndexOutofBounds Exception
parts:
I found out.
rhoptions should be set globally and not inside the mapreduce code.
Well, I hope I contributed to clarify this issue to the next newbie:)
